comment: 120 bpm: beat 0.5 s, bar 2 s. The wheel turns 72 degrees every 6 beats (3 s) and lands on t = 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 (the 15 s landing is the 0 s landing: the film loops with no seam). Each landing is a snare. Hi-hat = the clock tick (every 0.25 s, 60 per loop; the hand steps 6 degrees on each). Kick on every beat, clap on beats 2 and 4. One pitched blip per scene at its hero moment (land + hero).
